<user_input mode="plan">Option C</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">HV queue needs configuration for available HV agents (cline, copilot, claude, codex, grok) and either the agent's default (highest effort) model, or a model/effort specified in configuration.  The HV agent configuration must have endpoints and REPL coverage so Director and other tools can manage in real time.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">When a HV request is received, it must submit a range of session log turns to include in the review.  The reviewer must grade each turn individualy and apply their review score and update the turn record.  The result will include the score for each turn, and an overall score for the whole HV request.  HV request/results will be store in the database.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">worktree session-20261009 should have updates to the session log schema for storing both agent self-review and hv review outcome on the turn.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">> Found the architecture doc 

That document is the base we are building on in this plan.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">Review of a turn should be considered final as any subsequent changes should be reflected in a later turn.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">Do not waste tokens repeating a completed action.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">Session log may not allow updates to a turn with an HV review.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">> Nonterminal turn in range: refuse whole request?

A turn must have an agent review before it can be included in a HV.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">Turns submitted, but marked Unnecessary, should still be included in the overall HV grade for the request.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">> Overall score stays server-recomputed mean plus worst-turn floor with AGREE requiring every turn PASS?

No, overall HV is a holistic review of the whole set of turns submitted.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">If the request recieves a session id (not a session turn id) in the set of turns, then the totality of session turns in that session are included by default.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">plugin core should present all missing agent reviews as a list for the agent to perform review on.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">HV reviews must use a standard json payload for responses that must include the complete request, the complete jsonl response log, and delineated list of specific failures with adequest description to remediate.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">HV request must supply a free text field for agent to add specific context in markdown or yaml format.  The request should be parsed for MCP Server FR/TR/AC/UC in the workspace and provided to the reviewing agent in a delineated list.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">execution failures are to be triaged (prevent duplicates) and mark the HV agent as offline until resolved.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">If there are no HV agents available to perform a review, the endpoint must refuse the request and the plugin core add the necessary context.</user_input>
<user_input mode="plan">HV agent resolution should round-robin HV review agents, excluding the agent submitting the review.</user_input>

<user_input mode="plan">need endpoints for getting running hvs, their last reported output, and eta.  Need endpoints for cancelling any hv.  need endpoint to attach to sse strem of the output of any running hv</user_input>
